keyLimits.en: 500 monthly text credits, unlimited contacts and keywords, 3 user seats included, MMS at 3 credits each, extra credits billed at 5.5 cents each.

addOns.en: Local number rental at $10/month plus a $4 one-time activation fee; extra text credits at 5.5 cents each; carrier fees per message (~$0.0025 in the US, ~$0.0068 in Canada).

cautions.en: Pricing scales by monthly text credit volume (500 to 50,000+); the $29/mo figure is the entry tier only, and higher-volume plans cost more.
No credit card is required for the free trial, but there is no permanent free plan.

capabilities.en: Mass texting and two-way SMS/MMS messaging for marketing campaigns and alerts.
Automation features including auto-replies, drip campaigns, and an AI message generator.
Unlimited contacts and keywords included on the base plan, with 3 user seats.

limitations.en: No permanent free plan; only a no-credit-card-required trial to send a test message.
Message volume is capped by a monthly credit allowance, with additional per-message and carrier fees beyond the plan.

unknowns: The fetched annual price ($398.40/year = $33.20/month) is higher per month than the $29/month plan, which is inconsistent with typical 'save with annual billing' framing; likely reflects a different bundled credit allowance than the monthly plan, but this was not confirmed on the page, so annualPerMonth was left null pending local re-verification.
Full list of higher-volume plan tiers and their prices was not itemized on the fetched page.
